svg.title: Callout Studio in Spanish
svg.desc: The settings' main page in Spanish: production rows resolve their labels through the actual t() function and the repository's Spanish translation table, registered entirely offline. The real language-reset arrow shows the saved preference differs from the fixture's English Obsidian language.
